frank: Quick heads-up: Vendor (BlueFalcon) wants an ad-hoc PT against staging next Tue. We need to confirm RBAC handoff, KMS scope, evidence ingest path, and retest etiquette. looping @leila @kevin
leila: Keep it staging-only. Ephemeral SSO role for vendor, no long-lived creds. Can we restrict to specific service ARNs?
kevin: Yes. Plan: create `pt_bluefalcon_{id}` session role with a session policy that limits actions to `arn:aws:iam::111122223333:role/staging-*` and resource-level conditions for EC2/ELB describe/list only. KMS: grant GenerateDataKey+Decrypt on `alias/pt/bluefalcon-2026`.
frank: Can someone paste a minimal KMS statement we can share with them?
kevin: Minimal snippet for vendor review:
```
{
  "Effect": "Allow",
  "Action": ["kms:GenerateDataKey","kms:Decrypt"],
  "Resource": "arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/pt-bluefalcon-2026"
}
```
nisha: Audit requirements: enable CloudTrail data events for the S3 ingest prefix and object-level S3 events. Forward to our SIEM, tag events with `pt:bluefalcon` and keep retention 395 days.
frank: Evidence ingest: presigned PUTs to `s3://pt-evidence/bluefalcon/{eng}/incoming/`. Require header `x-amz-meta-sha256` and filename pattern `eng-<id>/<type>/<file>`. No multipart uploads. Enforce ObjectLock GOVERNANCE for 30d on locked objects.
evidence-bot: [INFO] Presign service must emit structured logs: {"svc":"presign","pt_id":"bluefalcon","uploader":"vendor","status":"ok|fail"} -> stream to /pt-presign for SIEM.
leila: Retest policy: vendor can request a single retest slot within 10 business days after we mark fixes deployed. We will confirm two candidate windows: low-traffic midnight slot (01:00-03:00 PT) or morning slot (07:00-09:00 PT). Oncall to confirm availability.
oncall: [BOT] PagerDuty stub created PD-PT-2026-BF. I'll cover the midnight slot if needed.
frank: Intake method: vendor may POST findings to our webhook which will create a `PT Intake` card on vuln-tracker. We triage internally, tag `pt-report`, then create remediation tickets. SLA: ack within 24h, triage note in 48h, mitigation plan within 5 business days for criticals.
kevin: Action items (owner / due):
- kevin: create session role + export session policy + KMS policy for vendor review (due EOD)
- leila: confirm final window and update runbook with handoff steps + key rotation checklist (due EOD)
- nisha: enable CloudTrail object events + SIEM forward + retention tag (due EOD)
- infra: enable presign constraints (max 250MB, single part), ObjectLock on locked prefix (ping infra)
frank: I'll send the vendor handshake email now with the S3 prefix and sample curl commands. Draft link: https://docs.internal.redwood/pt-quickhandshake (sending).
kevin: ack
leila: ack
nisha: ack
frank: Closing thread unless vendor asks for HSM-backed keys or longer retention. Reopen if blockers. Thanks all!
